[ASSISTANT] Recommended hook size for small to medium-sized amigurumi toys: 3.5mm to 4.5mm (US E/4 to 7).  
[ASSISTANT] Recommended yarn weight for small to medium-sized amigurumi toys: Worsted weight yarn (Medium weight, #4) or DK weight yarn (Light worsted weight, #3).  
[ASSISTANT] Suggested that with the recommended hook and yarn, toys would be around 6-10 inches (15-25 cm) in height or diameter.  
[ASSISTANT] Listed examples of small to medium-sized amigurumi toys: small animals (e.g., cats, dogs, rabbits), simple characters (e.g., robots, monsters), fruit or food-themed toys (e.g., apples, donuts).  
[ASSISTANT] Advised to check yarn fiber and adjust hook size accordingly based on thickness.  
[ASSISTANT] Suggested checking gauge (tension) by crocheting a small swatch.  
[ASSISTANT] Recommended starting with a smaller project if new to amigurumi.  
[ASSISTANT] Confirmed that worsted weight yarn can be used for amigurumi toys but may produce larger toys compared to DK or sport weight yarn.  
[ASSISTANT] Suggested using a larger hook (5mm or 5.5mm) for fingerless gloves made from worsted weight yarn.  
[ASSISTANT] Provided general size guidelines for fingerless gloves based on hand circumference and length.  
[ASSISTANT] Suggested measuring hand circumference and length for proper sizing of fingerless gloves.  
[ASSISTANT] Listed general size guidelines for fingerless gloves: Small (6-7 inches), Medium (7-8 inches), Large (8-9 inches), Extra Large (9-10 inches).  
[ASSISTANT] Advised to consider the recipient's hand shape and desired fit when sizing fingerless gloves.  
[ASSISTANT] Recommended using a stretchy stitch pattern for fingerless gloves.  
[ASSISTANT] Suggested testing the fit of fingerless gloves as they are crocheted.  
[ASSISTANT] Recommended using a smaller hook size for amigurumi toys compared to fingerless gloves to achieve a denser fabric.  
[ASSISTANT] Suggested starting with a hook size
